bibliographic.title: Exploring the Use of a Large Language Model for Data Extraction in Systematic Reviews: a Rapid Feasibility Study

relevance_to_mlgg: GPT-4 extraction from paper abstracts: ~80% accuracy across domains. Key finding: causal inference methods and study design are hardest to extract (maps to MLGG's leakage_risk inference). Prompt wording sensitivity documented.
key_findings: Causal inference methods and study design: most extraction errors
Prompt sensitive to minor wording changes and field ordering
actionable_for_mlgg: Expect leakage_risk fields to have highest error rate (inferential, like study design)
Prompt engineering: field label naming matters (n_participants > study_size)
Separate factual extraction (AUROC, sample size) from inferential assessment (leakage risk)
